grassland.name: GRASSLAND
grassland.material: short, lush, vivid spring-green grass, evenly cropped, with the faintest variation in tone across the patch
grassland.detail: a very small number of tiny detail tufts — three or four at most — sitting low against the grass
variants: an even, almost plain patch: the detail tufts are barely there, so this is the tile that does most of the work on a big field
three or four small clover clumps, slightly darker than the grass, scattered off-centre
two or three tiny white and pale-yellow wildflowers on short stems, and one small clover clump
a couple of low, slightly yellowed tufts and one small smooth stone half-buried in the grass

plains.name: PLAINS
plains.material: drier, sparser grass in warm olive and golden straw tones over a hint of pale earth showing between the blades
plains.detail: a few dry tufts and thin patches where the soil shows through
variants: an even patch with the soil barely showing: the plain tile a big field is mostly made of
two or three wispy straw-coloured tufts leaning the same way, as if in a light wind
a small bare patch of pale dry earth off-centre, with dry grass closing around it
a scatter of short dry stalks and one tiny dusty pebble

desert.name: DESERT
desert.material: warm pale golden sand, smooth and clean, with very soft broad ripples across it
desert.detail: almost nothing: this ground is meant to read as empty
variants: smooth clean sand with only the softest ripple: the plain tile a dune field is mostly made of
broader wind ripples running diagonally across the patch
two small rounded pebbles and a faint scatter of coarser grains
a very low, soft dune crest crossing one side of the patch

snow.name: SNOW
snow.material: clean bright snow, softly mounded, its shadows a pale cool blue and never grey
snow.detail: soft drifts and the gentlest sparkle, with no footprints and no ice
variants: an even, softly mounded field of clean snow: the plain tile
two low soft drifts crossing the patch, with a shallow hollow between them
a faint crust texture with a few tiny sparkles catching the light
a small rounded stone poking through the snow, with the snow banked softly against it

tundra.name: TUNDRA
tundra.material: cold, low, patchy ground cover — grey-green moss and pale lichen over dark damp soil that shows through in places
tundra.detail: flat clumps of moss and lichen, never anything that stands up tall
variants: an even carpet of grey-green moss with only a little soil showing: the plain tile
wider patches of dark soil between islands of moss
a spread of pale, almost mint-coloured lichen over the moss
two small frost-grey stones lying flat, with moss growing up against them

water.name: SHALLOW WATER
water.material: clear, bright cyan-to-turquoise shallow water, its bed just visible as a soft paler shape beneath the surface
water.detail: gentle surface ripples and a few small highlights; calm, never choppy
variants: calm, almost still water with the softest ripple: the plain tile
a set of gentle parallel ripples crossing the patch
a slightly paler patch where the bed rises closer to the surface
a scatter of small bright highlights where the light catches the ripples

crops.name: A FIELD OF RIPE WHEAT
crops.material: tall ripe wheat in warm golden straw and honey tones, the heads dense and even, standing in neat parallel rows that run diagonally across the patch
crops.detail: nothing but the crop itself — this is the middle of a field
variants: an even, healthy field: rows of full golden heads with the faintest variation in tone along them

crops_cut.name: A HARVESTED FIELD
crops_cut.material: pale cut stubble over bare warm-brown earth, the shorn stalks short and even, with the same diagonal rows still visible as lines in the soil
crops_cut.detail: nothing but the stubble and the soil — the crop has been taken
variants: an even field of short pale stubble, the rows reading as soft parallel lines, a little loose straw caught between them
